reason: PURE. The first thing I noticed was the one-hand tear sachet with both capsules in it, because I live out of a tote and always leave my pill bottle at home. I would try one box of the plain bisglycinate since that is what the sleep videos talk about, and free shipping at $29.99 keeps it under what I would stress over.
objection: Two big capsules every night, and size 00 is hard for me to swallow. If it is a chore I will quit, and $30 a month is real money on my budget.
would_change_my_mind: A cheaper first box or a smaller trial pack, like 7 sachets for about $9, so I can check the capsules go down easy before paying for 30.
